list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Day 1 Setup: Project structure, local DB with JSON, core entities, and service layer using Advanced Java
- Created base package structure under `org.ticket.booking` - Added core entity classes: `User`, `Train`, and `Ticket` - Defined user attributes including credentials and booking history - Embedded train details inside ticket object including seat layout and station timings - Implemented JSON-based local DB using `users.json` and `trains.json` - Mock data includes user bookings and train information - Integrated Jackson for JSON parsing and object mapping - Deserialization of nested objects for complex booking structures - Built initial services: `UserBookingService` and `TrainService` for basic business logic - Structured the seat matrix and station timing logic for each train - Verified basic data flow from JSON to POJOs and service interaction
Day-2 Implement train booking system with user management Add user authentication with secure password hashing Implement train search and seat booking functionality Create JSON-based data persistence Add booking management features Include basic test setup
